Objective
- One sentence goal.

Context
- Relevant background, links to code and docs (files, lines, tests).

Inputs/constraints
- Preconditions, data contracts, and non-goals.

Deliverables
- Code changes
- Tests
- Docs

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All tests pass (list commands)
- [ ] Behavior matches spec/fixtures
- [ ] Docs updated (CLAUDE.md, docs/*)

Risk and rollback
- Known risks and how to revert if needed.

Notes for agent
- Guardrails (do not modify generated files; keep scope narrow; add tests).
